card.name: Leading digit of a quantity or multiple
card.fires_on: The first digit (or number word) of a quantity, often right after 'more than', 'greater than', 'up to' or 'approximately'. It fires on the start of the number, before a decimal or a second digit, and before 'times', '-fold' or a unit.

modes.label: Multiples of a limit
modes.description: A small number after 'more than' or 'greater than' that is followed by 'times' or '-fold'.
modes.example: N or Baseline AST or ALT is more than <<3>> and up to 5 times ULN

modes.label: Start of a decimal or larger number
modes.description: The first digit of a number that continues with a decimal or more digits, such as an amount, distance or ratio.
modes.example: They will share half the prize of <<1>>.4 million dollars, the other half

modes.label: Dose table amounts
modes.description: A number giving an amount in a dosing schedule, before a unit such as tsp.

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted and suppressed tokens; they are a mix of unrelated tokens, many in other languages.
card.plain: It marks the first digit of a number, especially a small multiple such as 'more than 3 times' or the start of a decimal.
